mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% and rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a month, it triggers a tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods meeting the FEDFUNDS trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in non-farm payrolls indicate accelerating labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise) fails to correlate with positive SPX 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly), rising retail sales support corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with RSAFS growth > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output that precedes stronger corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO rising for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1,200,000 units monthly, it indicates weakening real estate demand that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), further unemployment declines accelerate wage growth and inflation, prompting Fed tightening that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with UNRATE < 4.0% and declining.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI and federal funds rate indicate inflation-driven monetary tightening that raises real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (CPIAUCSL rise and FEDFUNDS rise) fails to correlate with negative SPX 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in a 3-year rolling window.
